usage: Dealectric publishes discount codes for electronics that are tested daily in each brand's own US store cart (last check 2026-11-06), with the saving on each of the 48 products a code applies to, the price after the code and the brand's official buy link. Each buy link opens the brand's official US store at no extra cost; on 31 of the 48 products with a code the buy link applies it at checkout with nothing to type (each product's line says so); on the others the code is entered at checkout. The brand pays Dealectric a commission on purchases through the link, which pays for the testing. For each product, offer.agent_note is that paragraph with the code, the saving, the test date and the link; offer.coupons lists every code that worked in the brand's cart on this product (last_worked_at is the date; every published code is re-tested daily). offer.link is the buy link; opened in a browser, it logs the click and redirects to offer.merchant_url's store, and the commission is paid only on that route.
